WITH periods AS (SELECT reporting_period, period_start, period_end FROM sales_reports WHERE status = 'confirmed' ORDER BY period_start DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 6) SELECT p.reporting_period, SUM(po.total_amount) AS confirmed_amount, SUM(poi.quantity) AS confirmed_cases, COUNT(DISTINCT po.id) AS order_count FROM periods AS p LEFT JOIN purchase_orders AS po ON po.submitted_at >= CAST(p.period_start AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND po.submitted_at < (CAST(p.period_end AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 DAY') AND po.status = 'completed' LEFT JOIN purchase_order_items AS poi ON poi.po_id = po.id GROUP BY p.reporting_period, p.period_start ORDER BY p.period_start DESC
SELECT po_number, status, total_amount, eta_date FROM purchase_orders WHERE status <> 'completed' ORDER BY po_number LIMIT 100

WITH po AS (SELECT p.category, poi.sku, poi.product_name, SUM(poi.quantity) AS purchase_cases FROM purchase_order_items AS poi JOIN purchase_orders AS po0 ON po0.id = poi.po_id JOIN products AS p ON p.id = poi.product_id WHERE po0.submitted_at >= '2026-09-01' AND po0.submitted_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY p.category, poi.sku, poi.product_name), inv AS (SELECT p.category, rf.sku, p.product_name_en AS product_name, SUM(rf.numeric_value) AS stock_on_hand FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN sales_reports AS sr ON sr.id = rf.report_id JOIN products AS p ON p.id = rf.product_id WHERE sr.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.metric_key = 'stock_on_hand' AND rf.period_end >= '2026-09-01' AND rf.period_end < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY p.category, rf.sku, p.product_name_en) SELECT COALESCE(po.category, inv.category) AS category, COALESCE(po.sku, inv.sku) AS sku, COALESCE(po.product_name, inv.product_name) AS product_name, po.purchase_cases, inv.stock_on_hand FROM po FULL OUTER JOIN inv ON po.sku = inv.sku ORDER BY category, sku LIMIT 100

WITH last_period AS (SELECT period_start, period_end FROM sales_reports WHERE status = 'confirmed' ORDER BY period_end DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) SELECT p.category, SUM(f.numeric_value) FILTER(WHERE f.metric_key = 'revenue') AS purchase_amount, SUM(f.numeric_value) FILTER(WHERE f.metric_key = 'units_sold') AS purchase_cases, COUNT(*) AS fact_count FROM report_facts AS f JOIN sales_reports AS sr ON sr.id = f.report_id JOIN last_period AS lp ON sr.period_start = lp.period_start AND sr.period_end = lp.period_end LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.id = f.product_id WHERE f.status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category

WITH f AS (SELECT rf.sku, rf.metric_key, SUM(rf.numeric_value) AS total FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN sales_reports AS sr ON sr.id = rf.report_id WHERE sr.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.period_start >= '2026-09-01' AND rf.period_end <= '2026-09-30' AND rf.metric_key IN ('stock_on_hand', 'units_sold') GROUP BY rf.sku, rf.metric_key) SELECT p.sku, p.product_name_en, p.category, MAX(CASE WHEN f.metric_key = 'stock_on_hand' THEN f.total END) AS ending_stock, MAX(CASE WHEN f.metric_key = 'units_sold' THEN f.total END) AS units_sold FROM f LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.sku = f.sku GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name_en, p.category ORDER BY p.category, p.sku LIMIT 100

WITH periods AS (SELECT DISTINCT period_start, period_end FROM report_facts WHERE status = 'confirmed' AND metric_key = 'revenue' ORDER BY period_start DESC LIMIT 2), rev AS (SELECT rf.period_start, rf.period_end, SUM(rf.numeric_value) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS fact_count FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN periods AS p ON rf.period_start = p.period_start AND rf.period_end = p.period_end WHERE rf.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.metric_key = 'revenue' GROUP BY rf.period_start, rf.period_end) SELECT r.period_start, r.period_end, r.revenue, r.fact_count, c.id AS contract_id, c.annual_sales_target, c.annual_sales_target_currency FROM rev AS r LEFT JOIN contracts AS c ON c.status = 'active' ORDER BY r.period_start DESC

WITH periods AS (SELECT DISTINCT period_start, period_end FROM report_facts WHERE status = 'confirmed' AND metric_key = 'revenue' AND NOT period_start IS NULL ORDER BY period_start DESC LIMIT 2), rev AS (SELECT period_start, period_end, SUM(numeric_value) AS revenue FROM report_facts WHERE status = 'confirmed' AND metric_key = 'revenue' GROUP BY period_start, period_end), tgt AS (SELECT period_start, period_end, SUM(numeric_value) AS target FROM report_facts WHERE status = 'confirmed' AND metric_key IN ('sales_target', 'target', 'revenue_target', 'sales_goal', 'goal') GROUP BY period_start, period_end) SELECT p.period_start, p.period_end, r.revenue, t.target, CASE WHEN t.target IS NULL OR t.target = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(CAST((r.revenue / t.target * 100) AS DECIMAL), 2) END AS completion_pct FROM periods AS p LEFT JOIN rev AS r ON r.period_start = p.period_start AND r.period_end = p.period_end LEFT JOIN tgt AS t ON t.period_start = p.period_start AND t.period_end = p.period_end ORDER BY p.period_start DESC

WITH confirmed_reports AS (SELECT id, reporting_period, period_start, period_end FROM sales_reports WHERE status = 'confirmed'), periods AS (SELECT DISTINCT reporting_period, period_start, period_end FROM confirmed_reports ORDER BY period_start DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 6) SELECT p.reporting_period, p.period_start, p.period_end, SUM(f.numeric_value) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS fact_count FROM periods AS p JOIN confirmed_reports AS r ON r.reporting_period = p.reporting_period JOIN report_facts AS f ON f.report_id = r.id AND f.status = 'confirmed' AND f.metric_key = 'revenue' GROUP BY p.reporting_period, p.period_start, p.period_end ORDER BY p.period_start DESC NULLS LAST

WITH sales AS (SELECT rf.sku, SUM(rf.numeric_value) AS units_sold, COUNT(*) AS fact_count FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN sales_reports AS sr ON sr.id = rf.report_id WHERE sr.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.metric_key = 'units_sold' AND rf.period_start >= '2026-09-01' AND rf.period_end <= '2026-09-30' GROUP BY rf.sku) SELECT p.sku, p.product_name_en, s.units_sold, s.fact_count FROM sales AS s LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.sku = s.sku ORDER BY s.units_sold DESC LIMIT 100

WITH f AS (SELECT rf.sku, rf.product_id, rf.metric_key, rf.numeric_value FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN sales_reports AS sr ON sr.id = rf.report_id WHERE sr.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.period_start >= '2026-09-01' AND rf.period_end <= '2026-09-30' AND rf.metric_key IN ('units_sold', 'revenue')) SELECT COALESCE(p.sku, f.sku) AS sku, p.product_name_en AS product_name, SUM(CASE WHEN f.metric_key = 'units_sold' THEN f.numeric_value END) AS units_sold, SUM(CASE WHEN f.metric_key = 'revenue' THEN f.numeric_value END) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS fact_count FROM f LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.id = f.product_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.sku, f.sku), p.product_name_en ORDER BY revenue DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

WITH inv AS (SELECT rf.sku, rf.product_id, rf.numeric_value FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN sales_reports AS sr ON sr.id = rf.report_id WHERE sr.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.metric_key = 'stock_on_hand' AND sr.reporting_period = '2026-09') SELECT inv.sku, p.product_name_en, inv.numeric_value AS stock_on_hand FROM inv LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.id = inv.product_id ORDER BY inv.sku LIMIT 100
